title: Markets
loadFailed: The markets could not be loaded: {{message}}

region.description: Which of this region's countries are open as shops, and their languages, time zone and domain. Countries are added and removed in the Countries section of this page.
region.empty: This region has no countries, so it has no markets. Add countries with “Add countries” in the Countries section of this page; each one then appears here, closed until you open it.

drawer.title: {{country}}
drawer.description: The market of {{country}} in the region {{region}}.
drawer.openHint: An open country is a shop at its own address. A closed one answers 404.
drawer.languagesHint: The first language is the country's default. The languages are the store's locales (Store → Locales).
drawer.domainHint: A bare domain such as example.at, or empty.
drawer.failed: The market could not be saved: {{message}}

store.description: The shop-wide market settings. Locales and the default region are Medusa's own, above.
store.primaryCountryHint: The country the shop's root address (/) opens in.
store.fallbackMarketHint: The market search engines get for visitors with no matching language (hreflang x-default).
store.htmlLangHint: The lang attribute of the page. Empty uses the language and the country, such as de-AT.
store.localeHint: The store has several locales for this language; this one is used for its texts.
store.localeGoneHint: The locale saved for this language is no longer one of the store's. Choose the one to use.
store.matchDefaultRegion: Also set the store's default region to the primary country's region
store.drawerDescription: The primary country, the fallback market and how languages are written in the pages.
store.noOpenCountry: No country is open yet. Open one in its region's Markets panel.
